notes:
Lead: VP Product (Maya Lin). Use-case: auto-summarize inbound Zendesk tickets and apply tags/macros to drive routing and SLA escalation. Currently manual tagging creates 30% routing errors. POC scope: 2-week pilot on triage queue (EN/FR), ~500 tickets/day. Requirements: 95th pct end-to-end latency < 400ms for summarization call in fast path; must support spikes to 120 req/s during campaigns; fallback to smaller quantized model with degraded summary and explicit 'low-confidence' tag. Preference: runs on customer VPC for audit controls but open to Redwood hosted for speed if keys/KMS acceptable.

Timeline:
- 2026-02-10: Intro call (Jordan) — mapped current flow, explained Redwood routing, suggested POC.
- 2026-02-18: Security intake submitted (InfoSec) — asked for SOC2 report, KMS options, retention controls.
- 2026-03-03: Technical demo + live summarization (Priya) — demoed streaming vs batch; highlights: prefix caching reduced cost by ~25%.
- 2026-03-05: Fireflies call (ff_20260303_emberfield_demo) — Maya: "Need consistent summaries for handoff to L2".
- 2026-03-09: POC scope v2 shared (drive link). Legal asked about data residency and contract SLA.

POC metrics and acceptance criteria:
- Extractive short summary (1-2 lines) + 5 bullet tags, accuracy > 85% vs human tag set.
- Latency: median < 150ms, p95 < 400ms for hosted path.
- Cost target: <$0.012 per ticket processed during POC.
- Reliability: automatic fallback to smaller model + retry/backoff; queueing window 30s.

Integration specifics:
- Zendesk: use webhooks + Redwood streaming, macros to apply tags and suggested responses; will push summaries to private custom field.
- Freshdesk: alternative path via API; need sample Freshdesk webhooks for mapping.

Quotes / notes from stakeholders:
- Maya (VP Product): "We need tagging to be deterministic — ops hates surprises." 
- Head of Ops: concerned about bursty nightly emails from partners (peak 10x baseline) — wants RBAC + audit log.

Next steps (short):
- Complete security questionnaire (SEC-3411) — due 2026-03-17.
- Tech deep-dive with infra team (Priya + their SRE) — schedule week of 2026-03-16.
- Provide sample Zendesk webhook mapping and token rotation plan.

Open questions:
- Can Redwood guarantee KMS integration for hosted API or require Private? (legal asks)
- How will macros be versioned during model rollouts?
- Pricing model for high-volume nightly spikes.
